name: NoahFirst AI Assistant
author: noahfirstai

sections.description:
Try NoahFirst free for 30 days and give your store a 24/7 AI assistant that supports
customers instantly and helps turn visitors into buyers.

NoahFirst is an AI assistant designed for e-commerce stores running on WordPress.
Unlike generic bots that rely on external data or guesswork, NoahFirst uses your store’s
own data—products, inventory, and policies—to deliver accurate, on-brand
answers. It’s like having a digital version of your best store employee—one who
knows your catalog inside and out, know your customer the best

Why NoahFirst?

NoahFirst works differently from traditional chat tools. Instead of relying on
scripts or external data, it uses your store’s own products, inventory, and
policies as its source of truth—so every answer stays accurate, consistent,
and aligned with your brand.

Because NoahFirst operates directly on your store data, it can respond instantly
without waiting for human input, giving customers the clarity they need to
make decisions without delay.

Key Features

  • Content-Bound Intelligence: Uses your WooCommerce store data (products, inventory, policies) as the primary knowledge source
  • Real-Time Data Sync: Automatically reflects updates in stock, pricing, and product details without manual retraining
  • Context-Aware Response Engine: Understands customer intent and generates relevant answers based on your store data
  • Multi-Language Support: Responds to customers in multiple languages based on their input
  • Ecommerce-Native Integration: Connects directly with your store structure for accurate and consistent responses
  • Lightweight Script Loading: Runs asynchronously without blocking your site performance
  • No-Code Setup: Install and connect your store without manual training or configuration

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the NoahFirst plugin
  2. Connect your NoahFirst account
  3. NoahFirst syncs with your WooCommerce store data
  4. Your AI assistant is ready to answer customers instantly

Use Cases

  • When customers ask about product details, NoahFirst answers instantly using your store data
  • When shoppers check sizing, availability, or delivery, NoahFirst provides accurate responses in real time
  • When your team is unavailable, NoahFirst continues supporting customers 24/7
  • When visitors hesitate before buying, NoahFirst answers their questions and helps them move forward
  • During high traffic or campaigns, NoahFirst handles multiple conversations at once without delay

External Services

This plugin connects to the NoahFirst API (https://api.noahfirst.com) to provide AI-powered responses within your store.

Service: NoahFirst API
Purpose: Processes customer queries and store data to generate real-time responses.
Data Sent: Customer messages entered in the chat widget and relevant store data (such as product details, inventory, and store policies).
When Data is Sent: Data is transmitted only when a user submits a query through the chat interface or when the assistant is triggered to generate a response.
Subprocessors: This service relies on OpenAI (AI processing provider) and IDCloudHost (infrastructure provider). Data is processed solely to generate real-time responses and is not used to train shared or public AI models. All subprocessors are bound by data processing agreements requiring confidentiality and secure handling of data.
Security: All data is transmitted securely using HTTPS (TLS encryption). Data at rest is protected using infrastructure-level security controls.

Policies:
Privacy Policy: https://noahfirst.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://noahfirst.com/terms
Security: https://noahfirst.com/security
sections.faq:
Does NoahFirst require WooCommerce?

NoahFirst is optimized for WooCommerce stores but can also work on general WordPress websites.

Does NoahFirst use my store data?

Yes. NoahFirst uses your store’s own data to provide accurate and relevant answers.

Does NoahFirst slow down my website?

No. NoahFirst is lightweight and designed to run without affecting your site performance.

Is technical setup required?

No. NoahFirst is designed to work with minimal setup and no coding required.

Will the AI sound like a robot?

No. NoahFirst adapts to your brand voice. Whether your store is professional, playful, or premium, it responds in a way that feels natural and aligned with your brand.

Does the trial require a credit card?

No. You can start your 30-day free trial with no credit card required.
